subject: Follow-up: data handling confirmation & opt-out for model improvements
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medicaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: data handling confirmation & opt-out for model improvements

Hi Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have everything on record: 

- Your ask: MedicaAI will opt out of any training or model-improvement workflows that use customer data processed through Redwood.
- Logging/retention: you need access to request logs for troubleshooting; you indicated a preference for a 90-day retention window for request-level metadata (no PII in logs).
- Residency: production inference will remain in us-west1; logs may be stored in the same region unless otherwise requested.

What we can commit to today (subject to the addendum):
1) No data will be used to train or tune models on any hosted or shared Redwood model variants for MedicaAI.
2) We can configure request logging to redact user-provided PII fields and retain non-PII metadata for up to 90 days.
3) We will provide an audit checklist and evidence (SOC2 artifacts and sanitized log samples) for your compliance team.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll share a brief addendum draft for legal to review (DocuSign-ready).
- We’ll attach an audit-evidence checklist and examples of the sanitized logs for your security team to validate.
- Schedule a short technical call (30 min) to walk your infra team through the log redaction and retention controls.

Attachments: privacy-ack-optout.pdf (draft addendum), audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx

If that matches what you heard, please reply with confirmation and any changes to the retention window or residency requirement.

Thanks — talk soon.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
D +1 415-555-0123

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medicaai.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling confirmation & opt-out for model improvements

Thanks Dylan — this aligns with our expectations. A couple of clarifications from MedicaAI security/legal: 

- Confirmed: we require an explicit, written opt-out that prohibits any use of MedicaAI customer data for model training, feature improvement, or internal research.
- Retention: 90 days for non-PII request metadata is acceptable.
- Logs: any logged fields that could contain PII must be redacted at ingestion; please provide examples of the redaction transformation.
- Evidence: we will need SOC2 Type II summary and a sample of sanitized logs (sufficiently redacted).

Can you also indicate whether the addendum can be executed via DocuSign and how long your legal team typically needs to sign? We hope to have a countersigned addendum within two weeks.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medicaai.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling confirmation & opt-out for model improvements

Hi Priya — quick note from product/legal side: we can accommodate the items you listed. A few implementation details to set expectations for the technical review: 

- Addendum: we will prepare a short addendum that explicitly prohibits use of MedicaAI data for model training or evaluation. DocuSign execution is fine; our legal team typically turns third-party addenda in 3-5 business days.
- Retention & redaction: the platform supports configurable retention windows per-tenant. We will enable a 90-day metadata retention and deploy an ingestion redaction rule that strips configured PII fields (email, SSNs, free-text phone numbers). We will provide pseudonymized request IDs for troubleshooting.
- Audit evidence: attached are the draft addendum and the audit checklist we discussed. For sanitized logs, we can provide a one-page sample showing before/after redaction.

Attachments: redwood-addendum-draft.docx (addendum draft), privacy-ack-optout.pdf (opt-out statement), audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx

Next steps: 
1) We’ll send the DocuSign package by EOD tomorrow.
2) Sean — can you pick a 30-minute slot for a technical walkthrough with MedicaAI (suggest Wed 9/9 or Thu 9/10)?
3) Priya — once signed we’ll produce the sanitized log sample and SOC2 summary for your review.

Marissa Cole
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medicaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, contracts@medicaai.com
Date: 2026-09-08T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data handling confirmation & opt-out for model improvements

Thanks all — summary and immediate actions so nothing slips through: 

- Action (Redwood): Send DocuSign addendum (Marissa / legal) — target EOD 2026-09-08.
- Action (Redwood): Provide sanitized log sample and SOC2 summary once addendum is sent (Marissa).
- Action (Redwood): Technical walkthrough to validate redaction and retention controls (Sean to schedule; proposed 30-minute slot on Wed 2026-09-09 10:00 AM PT).
- Action (MedicaAI): Review and countersign addendum; confirm final retention/residency in signature comments.

Priya — if that timeline works I’ll mark the opportunity as "Privacy addendum in flight" in our CRM and loop legal for tracking. We appreciate the clarity here — we’ll make sure the addendum language is explicit about no-model-training and the log redaction approach.

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: privacy-ack-optout.pdf, audit-evidence-checklist.xlsx
